name: How long does kitchen sink and faucet coordination usually take?
description: Basic replacement can take a few hours, but custom fitting or plumbing changes can extend the job significantly.

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen sink and faucet coordination usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple replacement can often be completed in **a few hours**, but a full sink-and-faucet update may take longer if plumbing adjustments are needed. If the new faucet needs different holes, new lines, or countertop changes, plan for extra time.
